question: Where can I find a fast food restaurant in the south direction of Art Clinic, New York, NY, limited to 20 kilometers?
sql: SELECT poi_name, addr_city, addr_state FROM pois WHERE amenity = 'fast_food' AND ST_DWithin( geometry::geography, ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Art Clinic%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%New York%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%NY%' LIMIT 1 )::geography, 20000 ) AND degrees(ST_Azimuth( ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Art Clinic%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%New York%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%NY%' LIMIT 1 ), geometry )) BETWEEN 157.5 AND 202.5;
